Hellstone Shards are used as the currency for the second A Greedy Emissary event, taking place during patch 11.1.7. Trade the shards with Baranar at the Forgegrounds in Dornogal for recolors of the upgraded Tier 2 sets from the 20th Anniversary. The introductory quest, Hellhunters Wanted, awards 13 shards. Hero talents are a new system introduced in , intended to complement the existing talent system. Each class has three hero talent trees (except for druids, which have four), each one of which is shared by two specializations. Hero talent points are earned at every level starting at level 71, so that by level 80 every talent in the tree will be acquired.

Hexed Potatoad Mucus are looted from Sturdy Chest in Atal'Aman Delve. While under the effects of the item, the Potatoad Egg can be obtained from the Gravid Potatoad in the Blinding Vale.
Hex Lord's Gaze drops from The Coiled Altar in the Venomous Abyss.
Hex Lord's Visage is created by combining 4 Hex Troll Mask Fragment, which drop from The Coiled Altar in the Venomous Abyss.
Hex Master Jintagga is a forest troll located in the Maisara Deeps in Zul'Aman.
Hex Master Soye'mal is a forest troll located in the Maisara Deeps in Zul'Aman.
Hex Master Uy'okan is a forest troll located in the Maisara Deeps in Zul'Aman.
Hex Troll Mask Fragment drops from The Coiled Altar in the Venomous Abyss. 4 of these can be combined to create the Hex Lord's Visage.
Hesawa Stormwalker is an ally card from the Throne of the Tides set.

The Hexed Witchwick Collection is a collection of all the hexed witchwick transmog sets and broom mounts for retail, providing all 4 transmog sets and 4 mounts for $50 USD total. This collection was released on 8 October 2026 with no end date listed. The transmog sets with the matching broom mount are also available for purchase individually for $25 USD each.
High-Fiber Leaf is a world drop. It is a quest objective for To Tame A Thunderspine (2).
High Keeper Orendi is a titanic watcher located in Tyrhold Reservoir in Thaldraszus during Time Rifts.
High Channeler Ryvati is a tauren located in Ruby Overlook in Ruby Life Pools.
High Thaumaturge Fural is a djaradin located in Ravaged Rookery in Neltharus. He throws a potion at Magmatusk, but its eruption kills Fural.
High-Yield Radiation Bombs are created with Engineering (225); taught by Schematic: High-Yield Radiation Bomb.
Hidden Treasures: Krasarang Wilds is a pandaria remix achievement earned by finding the Saurok Stone Tablet in the Krasarang Wilds. The tablet is inside a cave at directly west of Zhu's Watch.
Hidden Treasures: Kun-Lai Summit is a pandaria remix achievement earned by finding three of the lost treasures hidden throughout Kun-Lai Summit.
Hidden Treasures: The Jade Forest is a pandaria remix achievement earned by finding two of the lost treasures hidden throughout the Jade Forest.
Hidden Treasures: Timeless Isle is a pandaria remix achievement earned by finding four of the lost treasures hidden throughout the Timeless Isle.
Hidden Treasures: Townlong Steppes is a pandaria remix achievement earned by finding two of the lost treasures hidden throughout Townlong Steppes.
Hidden Treasures: Valley of the Four Winds is a pandaria remix achievement earned by finding one of the lost treasures hidden throughout Valley of the Four Winds or the Veiled Stair.
High Speaker's Constructs are haulbots located in the Earthenworks in the Ringing Deeps.
High-Quality Coal is looted from Shipment Crates in Dornogal.
High-Grade Blade of the Forbade can be purchased at the Trading Post from the Weapons and Armor Outlet vendor for 60 Trader's Tender. Its original price was 100 Trader's Tender.

Eirich is the former High Speaker. He served on the Council of Dornogal as the representative of the Machine Speakers. After the Awakening Machine broke down he retreated to the Ringing Deeps to repair it. Unable to resolve the issue, Eirich eventually made a deal with Xal'atath and was later deposed because of it, with Speaker Brinthe taking over his position. He met his end soon after inside the Stonevault.
High Priest Aemya is an Arathi located at Sanctified Grounds in the Priory of the Sacred Flame.
Hide Vest of the Hungerer is a quest reward from Taragaman the Hungerer (quest).
High-Alert Thinking Cap is an achievement reward from I Saved the Party and All I Got Were These Lousy Hats.
High Nerubian Signet drops from Anub'ikkaj in the Dawnbreaker instance.
High Speaker's Accretion drops from the Void Speaker Eirich in the Stonevault.
The High Roller Suite is an area at the Gallagio in the Liberation of Undermine.

High Commander Beatrix is the second boss in the . As a military officer, she is escorted by many paladin and archmage hero units from such as Commander Granis Darkhammer and Archmagus Nilas Arcanister. She is also helped by Cardinal Stiltz, Bowmaster Puck, Knight-Captain Fratley, Arcanist Hilda, and Shield Warden Stein, who represent game mechanics from her fight.
Hideshaper's Cover is created with Khaz Algar Leatherworking. The crafting recipe can be learned from Leatherworking trainers in Khaz Algar upon reaching Khaz Algar Leatherworking (25).
Hideseeker's Pack is created with Khaz Algar Leatherworking. The crafting recipe can be learned from Leatherworking trainers in Khaz Algar upon reaching Khaz Algar Leatherworking (15).
Hideseeker's Hat is created with Khaz Algar Leatherworking. The crafting recipe can be learned from Leatherworking trainers in Khaz Algar upon reaching Khaz Algar Leatherworking (5).

Hidden Trove is a chest that spawns at the end of the delve if the player had used a Delver's Bounty. At Tier 8, it contains: * 100 Resonance Crystals * 200 Undercoin * 75 Valorstones * Hero 1 equipment * 4x Gilded crest * Curio (if not collected or upgraded to max already) During Turbo Boost, the gilded crest reward is doubled. Players can earn 20 gilded crests by using a map in an 11, up from 10 normally.

Hideshaper's Workbag is created with Khaz Algar Tailoring. The crafting recipe is taught by Pattern: Hideshaper's Workbag. When equipped, Resourcefulness rating is increased by 90 when crafting Leatherworking reagents.
Hideseeker's Tote is created with Khaz Algar Tailoring. The crafting recipe is taught by Pattern: Hideseeker's Tote. When equipped, the cooldown of Sharpen Your Knife recovers 10% faster.
The High Shaman's Aerie Gryphon is a gryphon mount is the Traveler's Log completion reward for September 2025.
Hidden Treasures: Stormheim is a Legion Remix achievement earned by discovering eight of the lost treasures hidden throughout Stormheim.
Hidden Treasures: Azsuna is a Legion Remix achievement earned by finding eight of the lost treasures hidden throughout Azsuna.
